bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
sha=801ac3f211db886fb72716c9066ba80e19cef308
git fetch --no-tags origin "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
stage="$(mktemp -d)"
chmod 700 "$stage"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
git show "$sha:scripts/recover_denied_general_topic_button.py" > "$stage/recover_denied_general_topic_button.py"
git show "$sha:scripts/publish_missing_normal_topic_buttons.py" > "$stage/publish_missing_normal_topic_buttons.py"
python3 -B "$stage/recover_denied_general_topic_button.py" --mode apply --group video
python3 -B "$stage/recover_denied_general_topic_button.py" --mode apply --group category
